summary: Configured the routed WireGuard LAN connection and persistent application path across all four nodes.
actions_performed: Configured VyOS gateways, WireGuard identities, tunnel addresses, peer routes, keepalives, and saved persistent state.
Configured node3/node4 LAN addresses and static routes with systemd-networkd persistence.
Enabled node3 HTTP service on TCP 8080 with root response containing “lan-a application”.
Applied stateful default-deny inter-LAN forwarding with only node4 → node3 TCP/8080 allowed.
Verified WireGuard handshakes, end-to-end HTTP access, blocked non-application traffic, preserved source address 10.70.2.10, and no NAT configured.
